title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.14
subtitle: Clean attachment state after object deletion.

highlights.title: Deleted objects cleaned up
highlights.description: Attachments to deleted source or target objects are removed automatically, so stale entries no longer block Bake.

highlights.title: Existing attachments preserved
highlights.description: Objects temporarily unlinked from the scene keep their attachments. Cleanup also handles old files when opened.
